assumptions.source_location: Spielanleitung p. 4, Spielenende; Almanach p. 10, Spielende
alternatives: After every committed atomic action, the active player wins immediately upon possessing at least 10 points, and only the minimum needed hidden victory-point cards are revealed.
Victory is checked only after the active player explicitly ends the turn.
assumptions.selected: After every committed atomic action, the active player wins immediately upon possessing at least 10 points, and only the minimum needed hidden victory-point cards are revealed.

assumptions.source_location: Spielanleitung p. 3 and Almanach p. 8, Längste Handelsstraße
alternatives: Longest Road is the maximum edge-simple trail; edges cannot repeat, vertices may repeat, and an opponent building stops traversal through its vertex.
Longest Road is the maximum vertex-simple path; neither edges nor vertices may repeat.
assumptions.selected: Longest Road is the maximum edge-simple trail; edges cannot repeat, vertices may repeat, and an opponent building stops traversal through its vertex.

assumptions.source_location: Spielanleitung p. 3 Binnenhandel; Almanach p. 6 Binnenhandel
alternatives: A domestic trade is represented as one finite bilateral offer; the active player adds give/take cards one at a time and the named partner accepts or rejects.
All players may negotiate an unbounded sequence of simultaneous counteroffers.
assumptions.selected: A domestic trade is represented as one finite bilateral offer; the active player adds give/take cards one at a time and the named partner accepts or rejects.
